channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, AI, Tech & Research, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, AI, Tech & Research, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 4 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.
  • Rory Peck Trust: Crisis Fund for Freelance Journalists
    https://rorypecktrust.org/get-help/crisis/crisis-fund/
    Rory Peck Trust · deadline Rolling / undated · Individual emergency grants; amounts are set case by case from an assessment of circumstances and need. No application fee.
  • IIE Scholar Rescue Fund (IIE-SRF) Fellowship for Threatened and Displaced Scholars
    https://www.iie.org/programs/scholar-rescue-fund/for-scholars/
    Institute of International Education (IIE), Scholar Rescue Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Fellowship of up to USD 30,000 for one year, paid towards a temporary academic position at a host institution; in most cases renewable for a second and final year. No application fee.
  • Digital Defenders Partnership: Incident Response Fund
    https://www.digitaldefenders.org/funds/
    Digital Defenders Partnership (DDP), hosted by Hivos · deadline Rolling / undated · Rapid-response grants of up to USD 5,000 (historically up to EUR 10,000) for costs that directly reduce the risk or impact of a digital attack, covering activities for a maximum of four months. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:

    Fundacion Cotec and Sonar+D · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 100,000 (plus VAT), all-inclusive: conceptualisation, design, technical development, production, installation, maintenance, documentation, artist fees, travel, accommodation and insurance.

    https://cultuurloketdigitall.nl/implementatiebijdrage/
    Cultuurloket DigitALL · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Up to EUR 30,000. Covers technical modification, system integration, production and deployment costs. Hardware purchase alone is ineligible unless clearly essential to the public experience. No stated co-financing percentage. No application fee.
  • Cultuurloket DigitALL: Pilot Contribution (Pilotbijdrage, 2026-2027, rolling)
    https://cultuurloketdigitall.nl/pilotbijdrage/

item.title: 2 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• India Foundation for the Arts: Arts Research Programme (May 2026 Request for Proposals)
    https://indiaifa.org/whats-new/ar-rfp-may2026.html
    India Foundation for the Arts (IFA) · deadline Closed 10 Aug 2026 · Up to INR 500,000 (around USD 5,700 / EUR 4,900) per project. Honorarium is capped at 35 percent of the budget. Institutional overhead, building costs, infrastructure and equipment purchases are excluded. No application fee.
  • Innovate UK: Next Wave Breakthrough Wave 1, Createch (2026)
    https://apply-for-innovation-funding.service.gov.uk/competition/2517/overview/6ff2066d-4639-44e6-bb4f-ce7099222739
    Innovate UK, UK Research and Innovation · deadline Closed 11 Aug 2026 · GBP 100,000 to 500,000 total project costs from a GBP 10 million fund; no organisation may receive more than GBP 3 million across the programme. Grant intervention rates for industrial research: up to 70 percent for micro and small enterprises, 60 percent for medium, 50 percent for large. Research organisations doing non-economic work can claim up to 100 percent, or 80 percent of full economic cost for academic institutions. The balance is match funding. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research grant - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Building Narrative Power: EUR 2m funding and learning programme
    https://europeanaifund.org/newspublications/call-for-proposals-new-e2m-building-narrative-power-funding-and-learning-programme/
    European AI & Society Fund · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Grants of up to EUR 150,000 from a EUR 2 million programme, plus a place in the accompanying learning programme and community of practice. Payments are usually 50% on grant signing, 40% midway through the grant period subject to previous funds having been spent, and 10% on completion. As a general rule organisations should not request more than their previous annual budget unless the need is motivated and demonstrated; without a previous annual budget, request an amount proportional to the project. No application fee.

item.title: 5 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Musikfonds: STIP-6 AI Scholarship Programme 2027 (Germany)
    https://www.musikfonds.de/foerderprogramme
    musikfonds e.V. · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · EUR 30,000 lump sum per scholarship, paid in twelve monthly installments across January to December 2027. Ten scholarships available. No application fee.
  • Longview Philanthropy: Digital Minds Grants for Applied Work 2026
    https://www.longview.org/request-for-proposals-research-and-applied-work-on-digital-minds/
    Longview Philanthropy · deadline Closed 10 Jul 2026 · Typical grants $50,000–$2,000,000 per project; proposals outside this range considered when the work justifies it. May include some operational support for new organisations. No application fee.
  • Scaling AI Safety for a Multi-Agent World (Joint Funding Call)
    https://schmidtsciences.smapply.io/prog/scaling_ai_safety_for_a_multi_agent_world/
    Schmidt Sciences, Google DeepMind, the Advanced Research & Invention Agency (ARIA), the Cooperative AI Foundation, and Google.org · deadline Closed 08 Aug 2026 · Two funding tiers (applicants may apply to either or both), projects 1 to 2 years. Tier 1: up to USD 300,000 for exploratory research, pilot studies, or focused technical investigations. Tier 2: USD 300,000 to USD 1,000,000 for more ambitious or collaborative projects. For projects funded by Schmidt Sciences, indirect costs must be at or below 10%. No application fee.
  • Eurostars Call 11 2026 (Eureka / Eurostars-3)
    https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programmes-and-calls/eurostars/eurostars-call-for-projects-september-2026/
    Eureka / Eurostars-3 (Dutch participation via RVO) · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · Co-funds collaborative international R&D; national funding varies by country. For the Dutch project share: up to EUR 500,000 per project at 50 percent reimbursement of eligible R&D costs. No application fee.
  • MIT R&D Collaboration Projects 2026 (MKB Innovatiestimulering Topsectoren)
    https://www.rvo.nl/subsidies-financiering/mit/rd-samenwerkingsprojecten
    Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Grant covering 35 percent of eligible costs. Small projects EUR 50,000-200,000; large projects EUR 200,000-350,000 per project (EUR 25,000-100,000 or EUR 25,000-175,000 per participant). No application fee.
